tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search claims and evidence in the Kotowari knowledge workspace with sourced explanations.

query.description: Natural language question or keywords to search knowledge.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Search agent memory records scoped to the current workspace namespace.

query.description: Natural language query for memory recall.

limit.description: Maximum number of memory records to return.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision with context snapshot, considered evidence, and selected outcome.

rationale.description: Brief rationale for the decision (not hidden chain-of-thought).

contextSnapshotId.description: Context snapshot id from a prior context.build call.

consideredEvidenceIds.description: Evidence ids considered when making the decision.
